register.title: Create Account
register.subtitle: Join WatchOver to track your devices

guide.tocSubtitle: Select a topic to learn more
guide.sec1Intro: Follow these steps to create your WatchOver account:
guide.sec1Step1Desc: Provide a valid email address that you have access to.
guide.sec1Step2Desc: Choose a secure password with at least 6 characters.
guide.sec1Step3Desc: Re-enter your password to confirm it matches.
guide.sec1Step4Desc: Check your inbox and click the verification link we send you.
guide.sec1Step5Desc: Once verified, return to the login page and sign in with your credentials.
guide.sec2Intro: The map displays real-time location data for your device:
guide.sec2Feature1Desc: Shows the current location of your device. This updates in real-time when new GPS data is received.
guide.sec2Feature2Desc: The circle represents your safe zone boundary. You'll be notified if the device leaves this area.
guide.sec3Intro: The dashboard panel displays all your device information:
guide.sec3Item1Desc: At the top, you can add or remove your WatchOver devices.
guide.sec3Item2Desc: The name of the person wearing the device. You can customize this.
guide.sec3Item3Desc: Shows the address or coordinates of the device's latest position.
guide.sec3Item4Desc: Displays when the device last transmitted location data.
guide.sec3Item5Desc: Shows the remaining battery percentage of your device.
guide.sec3Item6Desc: Indicates whether the device is Online or Offline.
guide.sec4Btn1Desc: Sends a vibration alert to the device for 10 seconds. Useful for getting the wearer's attention.
guide.sec4Btn2Desc: Update the password for your device to enhance security.
guide.sec4Btn3Desc: View past location records and movement history of your device.
guide.sec5Intro: The bottom navigation bar has 3 buttons:
guide.sec5Nav1Desc: Click to draw a circle on the map defining a safe zone for your device.
guide.sec5Nav2Desc: Update your account login password for security.
guide.sec5Nav3Desc: Securely sign out of your WatchOver account.
guide.sec6Tip: Use the language buttons at the top right corner of the screen to switch between English and Tagalog.
guide.sec7Add1: Find the Device ID sticker on the back of your WatchOver device.
guide.sec7Add2: Click the "Add Device" button in the dashboard.
guide.sec7Add3: Enter the Device ID and default password (12345).
guide.sec7Add4: You will be prompted to change the device password immediately.
guide.sec7Remove1: Click the "X" button next to the device name in the device list.
guide.sec8Intro: If you forgot your account password, follow these steps to recover it:
guide.sec8Step1: Click "Forgot Password?" on the login page.
guide.sec8Step2: Enter the email address associated with your account.
guide.sec8Step3: Check your inbox for a password reset link.
guide.sec8Step4: Click the link and create a new password.
guide.sec8Step5: Return to the login page and sign in with your new password.
guide.sec8Tip: If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.
